title: Strings with an upper-case radix prefix
notes: The Core schema accepts only the lower-case prefixes 0x and 0o, and YAML 1.1 only 0x and 0b, so these are strings under both. Some readers accept an upper-case prefix (`0B1`, `0XFF`, `0O7` read as numbers in yaml.v2 and v3); the family also quotes a prefix followed by a sign. The Core-schema reading (loose) is the specification. The reading under YAML 1.1 and the number forms that some common readers accept (strict) is a writing convention of the family: a string is written plain only when it reads as that same string there too.

provenance.reference: Strings with an upper-case radix prefix written without quotes; common readers that detect the base take them as numbers.
